reason: I'll start with the dusty disk and stones to pursue the giant's moon-forming material.
expectation: The stones may gather with material in the disk into larger bodies, though I don't know if moons form yet.

alternatives.reason: The ice-rich material also fits a goal, but I'll follow the dusty disk first.

effect: The dusty disk and stones formed rocky moonlets, which can now encounter dust or icy fragments.
reaction: It's satisfying to see the stones gather into moonlets.
reason: I'll follow the rocky moonlets as they encounter more dust.
expectation: The moonlets may collect dust and grow, though the outcome is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The ice-rich material also needs following, but I'll continue the rocky-moonlet path first.
Icy fragments could also interact with the moonlets, but dust seems a natural next step.

effect: A moonlet gathered dust and became a rocky moon around the giant. I can now follow its encounters or start the ice-rich path.
reaction: It's satisfying to see the moonlet become a moon.
reason: I'll follow the rocky moon's encounter with the fast stones before turning to the ice-rich material.
expectation: The fast stones may crater or damage the moon; I'm unsure how severe the impacts will be.

alternatives.reason: The ice-rich material also needs following, but I want to see what happens to the rocky moon first.

effect: The impacts cratered the same rocky moon and completed the moon-forming goal; the ice-rich path remains.
reaction: The cratering was as expected, and it's useful to see the same moon persist.
reason: I'll follow the ice-rich material; it's the only available combination.
expectation: The rock and ice may gather into icy moonlets, though their fate is uncertain.

effect: The ice-rich material formed moonlets that can now encounter fragments, dust, or fast stones.
reaction: The parallel with the rocky moonlets is clear, though predictable.
reason: I'll follow the fragile moonlets into an encounter with fast stones to see whether they break apart.
expectation: The impact may shatter some moonlets into fragments, though the outcome is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: Icy fragments might help the moonlets grow, but the impact seems more relevant to their fragility.

effect: The impact shattered a smaller icy moonlet, completing the remaining goal and contrasting with the rocky moon's cratering.
reaction: The outcome matched my expectation; the contrast between damage and disruption was useful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the rocky moon through formation and cratering was satisfying because the same moon persisted through the encounters.

leastWorthwhile.text: Forming the ice-rich moonlets felt predictable after the parallel rocky sequence.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the fragile moonlet broke as I expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary, though the menu supplied compatible combinations rather than requiring me to discover them.

continue.text: Probably not immediately: the contrasting impact outcomes were interesting, but the parallel moonlet sequences felt predictable.
